name: Cryogenic probing of 300-mm Si/SiGe spin-qubit wafers at 1.6 K for single-electron operating-voltage statistics
plain_name: Test whole 300 mm silicon qubit wafers for single-electron behaviour below 2 K
description: Load full 300-mm Intel Si/Si0.7Ge0.3 spin-qubit wafers into a cryo-prober (1.0 K at the chuck, 1.6 K electron temperature, about 2 h cooldown), lift device pads into contact with a probe-pin array and map single-electron transitions, gate-line resistance and superconducting process monitors across the wafer.
keywords: Test whole 300 mm silicon qubit wafers for single-electron behaviour below 2 K

sources.citation: Probing single electrons across 300 mm spin qubit wafers (Neyens et al., arXiv:2307.04812v2; Nature 629, 80-85, 2024)

reported_equipment: cryo-prober manufactured by Bluefors and AEM Afore

requirements.rationale: Single-electron operation and validation of the superconducting process rely on the 1.6 K base temperature of the cryo-prober.
Whole 300 mm wafers are loaded and cooled.
Device pads must be electrically contacted by probe pins at temperature.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
